responsibility: Extends `rustc_infer`’s inference context with trait-selection-specific operations and canonical trait-query execution. This root file adds convenience APIs for checking equality and common trait predicates under obligations, performing shallow or full trait-implementation tests through selection and fulfillment, and running canonicalized trait queries by creating an inference context, executing an obligation-producing operation, and packaging the canonical response. It is responsible for entering canonical trait queries with the correct inference context, including enabling opaque type inference with a defining anchor so trait queries can define or constrain return-position opaque hidden types instead of failing when predicate proving encounters an opaque produced by the same item.
